comparison.objective: Open a can by maintaining cutter engagement while cranking and infer progress from can rotation, rather than tune impact absorption.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual lever force plus continuous cranking; candidate requires intermittent hex-key work, collar micro-rotation, relocking, and cycle inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Can opened and lid placed in tray; explicit cut-completion, contamination, force, and damage thresholds are not supplied.
comparison.reason: Although both use observed motion and bimanual force, synchronized cutting is meaningfully different from iterative calibration across guarded impact cycles.
